senses.gloss: लुट् (I) vt. or vi. 1P (pres. लुंटति) 1. To rob, to deprive of; 2. to go, to move; 3. to be lame, to be crippled; 4. to be idle.
लुट् (II) vt. or vi. 1Ā (pres. लोटते) 1. To shine; 2. to resist, to oppose; 3. to suffer pain.
लुट् (III) vt. or vi. 4P (pres. लुट्यति) 1. To be connected with; 2. to rob, to deprive of; 3. to roll on the ground, to wallow.
लुट् (IV) vt. 10U (pres. लोटयति-ते) 1. To speak; 2. to illumine.
